messages:
alice: Heads up — noticing a ~12% spike in 5xx on hosted inference since this morning's canary. Errors mainly 502/504 + timeouts. dashboard: https://dash.reddemo.com/r/abc123 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T09:12Z by bob — rollout: canary (5%) -> matrix flags: auth-proxy=true, prefetch-window=120ms, kernel-path=v2

bob: Confirmed I rolled auth-proxy flag scoped to `service:inference-canary` but looks like the selector got applied to `namespace=hosted` by mistake in the rollout job. Investigating why the selector expanded.

carol: Logs: upstream errors show auth middleware returning 500 from auth-proxy service when header size > 8kb. stack trace snippet: `authproxy: header_parse: truncated header -> panic?`

carol: Also seeing gateway timeouts where worker pods are dropping connections while trying to handshake to auth-proxy.

alice: Quick repro: curl against hosted endpoint fails 50% of the time with 502. repro steps I used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <long-token>" \n  -H "X-Client-Meta: $(head -c 9000 /dev/urandom | base64)" \n  https://api.reddemo.com/v1/generate
```
response: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` + `upstream prematurely closed connection`

frank: If auth-proxy is in front of a subset but got globally enabled, it may be trying to validate larger payloads synchronously and blocking workers. That lines up with the latency + 504s.

dave: Reproduced locally from eu region with the same long header, got 502 and a correlate in the ingress: `timeout waiting for upstream` and `502 read close`.

eve: Customer support reporting elevated error rates -> billing alerts from a few big tenants. Seeing retries from SDKs causing token consumption to spike. We should prioritize rollback if fix not immediate.

gwen: Ops: can we rollback just the flag flip to previous state for hosted env? We need a scoped rollback plan so dedicated customers unaffected.

ops-sre: I can run a scoped rollback of the feature flag targeting the hosted namespace. Command to run: `flagctl set auth-proxy --env=hosted --value=false --annotate=rollback-7401234567` — will do on approval.

alice: Approve. Please include a short canary (2 min) to confirm before full unroll.

ops-sre: Running rollback now. patching flag config in configstore -> applying to controllers.

deploy-bot: Flag change applied: auth-proxy=false to env=hosted, rollout: 100% in ~45s. change-id: chg_0x9f3b

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged (INC-20260317-1432). On-call: gwen.

carol: After rollback I see auth-proxy calls drop to baseline and worker queue depth returning to normal. No more header truncation traces.

alice: Error rate dropping — from 12% -> 1.8% over the last 3m. Latency 95p back to normal.

frank: Postmortem action items: 1) tighten selector matching on rollout job 2) add size guard/validation in auth-proxy when enabled 3) add automatic fallback to bypass auth-proxy if upstream errors exceed threshold 4) add a smoke test sending long headers during canary phase.

gwen: I'll own (#1) and (#4). bob, please own the rollout job change and add stronger tests. carol, please file a ticket for auth-proxy validation.

bob: Ack — will PR today for rollout selector and add smoke to pipeline.

alice: Thanks everyone. I'll update the support channel and affected customers with ETA for root-cause and rollback note.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved (INC-20260317-1432) — monitoring for 30m post-change.
